name: Fenner's yard and the rope-walk shed
region: Andorhal granary district, Mill Lane; reached from Hurdle Lane at the rope-walk end

sensoryProfile.sight: A yard of beaten earth behind Fenner's granary. Along one side the old rope-walk shed: long, low, windowless, a door at each end with a hasp and padlock on each. A trough, a hoist platform with an outside ladder, a gate, a cooper's door across the yard where one of Havel's lads stands, lanterns on hooks lit by a boy with a taper. Day crew coming off: men sitting on sacks with caps off, drinking at the trough, a man coiling rope on the platform.
sensoryProfile.sound: The yard goes quiet as the sentries take their places; the Exchange bell at full dark.
sensoryProfile.smell: Not stated beyond the district's grain dust.
sensoryProfile.touch: A wagon's tail at the lane corner where Sylvanas watches the yard over the horses' backs.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: A yard where most of the men are tired and eight are not.

establishedFacts.fact: Fenner's and the Exchange changed suppliers in the same week at high summer; Fenner's yard-reeve Coll Simmons has been there twenty years and is frightened of the loaders. The new supplier fitted a door and a lock on each end of the rope-walk; the loaders sleep there.

Eight sentries hold the yard (see character andorhal-cult-cell): two at the shed's near corner, two at the trough, one on the hoist platform, three by the gate. At the bell the crew go into the far door and the lock goes on from inside; the pair from the trough go in last; the three from the gate go up Hurdle Lane.

A bench in the cooper's doorway is where Havel suggests Sylvanas stand ('nobody looks twice at a man in a doorway'); she declines. Havel offers a ladder to Fenner's loft via Simmons; she refuses ('I'll find my own').
Havel took two loaders at midsummer for a brawl that never happened; the magistrate released them by dinner; their factor wrote to the council about Havel's manners.

eventsHere.event: Sylvanas and Cyndia read the yard from the lane corner; Cyndia counts eight; the runner leaves; Sylvanas goes up Hurdle Lane after him.
